issues.on_page: Property taxes 299,061 (p4) = Property taxes-county 276,255 + Motor vehicle taxes-county 22,806 (p7 budget schedule, Actual)
issues.issue: The printed property tax line includes 22,806 of motor vehicle tax according to the budget-basis schedule, and the County Treasurer's Fund schedule (p9) shows homestead, property tax credit, carline, prorate and housing authority money in the levy receipts. It is kept whole as printed. The County Treasurer's Fund schedule p9 is left out of the detail. Both are defensible, but the user should know.
detail_category is refuse/sanitation charges. Under the user's rule, garbage/refuse charges are category Utility Charges.

detail_category is recreation/pool/park fees. Under the user's rule (pool, park, golf), the category would be Recreation Fees. The Park department line (detail[10], 7,648) has the same mismatch, while the Cemetery line was given Cemetery Fees.

issues.on_page: Golf Course Fund: Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 3,300
issues.issue: A golf course fund's fees are more likely green/membership fees (Recreation Fees) than licenses and permits. The label is mixed, so this is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Fees 17,650 (Water 150, Sewer 8,669, Electric 8,831), printed under Charges for services
